correctness.rationale: A complete proof uses flat-addition injectivity on surviving nonzero images, the fact that every nonzero product is one fixed annihilator, and a dichotomy according to whether that element is preserved or killed. The preserved case consists exactly of \(n!\) simultaneous permutations; the killed case is exactly all partial injective maps into a matching-free subset of short intervals plus optional annihilator. The generating polynomial \((1+z)(1+2z)^n\) and falling factorial give every rank count, while all idempotent maps are the identity or projections onto matching-free short-interval subsets. Direct full operation-table checks for \(n=1,2\) and a separate rank-assignment census for \(n=3\) from local standalone `verify.py` returned VERIFY_OK; finite tests do not substitute for the proof.

value.rationale: The family contains the six-element canonical generator of the bounded-height semiring variety \(\mathcal B_2\), so its self-maps are natural algebraic invariants. One infinite-family theorem describes the entire endomorphism monoid, every image-size multiplicity, a forbidden interval of intermediate ranks, the unit group, and the idempotent retractions. The sharp six-element rank-five obstruction and exact count 215 are consequences, not an isolated arbitrary parameter computation. The result is narrowly but substantively motivated, with no claimed broader-poset or external validation.
